raw_register_flow.friendly_true: Same intelligence ECX/source stack as EXE. Friendly EXE sets EDX=victim pedType and ECX=source pedType before return. Wrapper returns EAX2 without changing ECX/EDX.
raw_register_flow.isplayer_true: IsPlayer EXE receives ECX=source, preserves ECX/EDX; wrapper TEST AL then MOV EAX1 preserves ECX/EDX.
raw_register_flow.isplayer_false: Wrapper XOR EAX,EAX preserves ECX/EDX, EXE MOV EAX,EBX (zero) preserves flags of preceding TEST AL. Raw EAX/ECX/EDX same; AF is undefined in TEST/XOR and no universal EFLAGS identity claimed.
